#### Data Analysis

Q. 1

What is the treatment variable? The message sent.

Is the variable discrete or continuous? Discrete

What is the variable's data type? Character

Q. 2

```{r}
bi.message<- voting%>%
  mutate(Binary_Message=ifelse(message=="yes",1,0))

```

Q. 3 
```{r}
head(bi.message)
# Did they receive the message:
# 'no' is everyone who did not receive a message
#'yes' is eveyone who did receive a message 
no<- bi.message%>%
  filter(Binary_Message==0)
yes<-bi.message%>%
  filter(Binary_Message==1)
#once filtered,  I take the mean of the voted variable. 
mean(no$voted)
mean(yes$voted)

```
